description: HEXDDD-01 exploratory pilot (NOT Study 2b, not registered). Design: ops/notes/hexddd-01-violation-elicitation-design.md section 5 (2-case pilot: S1-debt Hexagonal, S2-debt DDD). Arm none, claude-sonnet-5-5 through the Claude CLI, 1 replicate per task = 2 runs x 5 steps = 10 step turns, 0 repair turns. Hard cap 12 generator calls (one infrastructure redraw per run), enforced by the pilot driver's call ledger (run-pilot.ts), not by the loop harness. Run with run-pilot.ts, which reuses the loop harness (scripts/lib/loop) unchanged and adds only the seed start and the brownfield frame (design section 8 items 1 and 2). The taskProfiles style fields select the evaluator spec only: the driver replaces the harness frame, so no style, layer or folder sentence reaches the agent.
